1. Gangnam-gu (Каннамгу).plastic: Rinse clean, remove vinyl labels/caps. Place in transparent bags.
1. Gangnam-gu (Каннамгу).paper: Flatten boxes, remove tape and spiral binders from notebooks.
1. Gangnam-gu (Каннамгу).glass: Rinse empty bottles. Do not break.
1. Gangnam-gu (Каннамгу).organic: Drain all water. Use the designated YELLOW food waste bag.
1. Gangnam-gu (Каннамгу).general: Dispose in WHITE / BEIGE Gangnam-gu general trash bags.

2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).plastic: Clean out food residues. Separate clear PET from colored plastic.
2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).paper: Keep dry, fold cardboard boxes neatly.
2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).glass: Remove caps, dispose in clear glass recycling containers.
2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).metal: Crush food and drink cans before disposal.
2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).organic: Drain moisture completely. Use PINK Mapo-gu food waste bags.
2. Mapo-gu (Мапогу).general: Dispose in WHITE Mapo-gu standard waste bags.

3. Yongsan-gu (Йонсангу).plastic: Remove labels and caps. Dispose in transparent recycling bags.
3. Yongsan-gu (Йонсангу).paper: Bundle paper items together. Keep dry.
3. Yongsan-gu (Йонсангу).glass: Empty and rinse out containers completely.
3. Yongsan-gu (Йонсангу).organic: Use ORANGE Yongsan-gu food waste bags after draining water.
3. Yongsan-gu (Йонсангу).general: Dispose in WHITE Yongsan-gu general trash bags.

4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).plastic: Separate labels and place in transparent plastic recycling.
4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).paper: Remove tape, stickers, and metal bindings.
4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).glass: Rinse out liquids. Do not include broken light bulbs.
4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).metal: Crush metal cans to save space.
4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).organic: Use YELLOW Jongno-gu food waste bags.
4. Jongno-gu (Чонногу).general: Use standard WHITE Jongno-gu volume-rate bags.

5. Seongdong-gu (Сондонгу).paper: Flatten boxes and tie dry paper with string.
5. Seongdong-gu (Сондонгу).organic: Use BLUE Seongdong-gu food waste bags.

6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).plastic: Separate clear PET bottles into dedicated clear bins.
6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).paper: Remove non-paper elements like tape or plastic wrapping.
6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).glass: Rinse and dispose in designated glass bins.
6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).metal: Flatten clean tin and aluminum cans.
6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).organic: Use YELLOW Gwanak-gu food waste bags.
6. Gwanak-gu (Кванакку).general: Use WHITE Gwanak-gu standard volume bags.

7. Seodaemun-gu (Содемунгу).plastic: Rinse thoroughly and remove all labels.
7. Seodaemun-gu (Содемунгу).organic: Use PINK or YELLOW Seodaemun-gu food waste bags.
7. Seodaemun-gu (Содемунгу).general: Use WHITE Seodaemun-gu general trash bags.

8. Seongbuk-gu (Сондокку).plastic: Dispose in clear transparent bags after rinsing.
8. Seongbuk-gu (Сондокку).paper: Flatten boxes and bind paper neatly.
8. Seongbuk-gu (Сондокку).organic: Use GREEN Seongbuk-gu food waste bags.
8. Seongbuk-gu (Сондокку).general: Use WHITE Seongbuk-gu standard trash bags.

9. Dongdaemun-gu (Тондэмунгу).plastic: Clean out residue, detach plastic film labels.
9. Dongdaemun-gu (Тондэмунгу).paper: Fold boxes flat and remove any adhesive tape.
9. Dongdaemun-gu (Тондэмунгу).glass: Rinse out liquids and dispose safely.
9. Dongdaemun-gu (Тондэмунгу).organic: Use ORANGE Dongdaemun-gu food waste bags.
9. Dongdaemun-gu (Тондэмунгу).general: Use WHITE Dongdaemun-gu general waste bags.

10. Songpa-gu (Сонпагу).plastic: Separate clear PET bottles completely from general plastics.
10. Songpa-gu (Сонпагу).glass: Remove caps and labels where possible.
10. Songpa-gu (Сонпагу).organic: Use YELLOW Songpa-gu food waste bags or RFID disposal points.
10. Songpa-gu (Сонпагу).general: Use official WHITE Songpa-gu trash bags.
